4: From the numbers of the eight-element set $Z=\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9\}$ we form an eight-term sequence whose terms do not repeat. Calculate the probability of the event that no two even numbers are adjacent terms of the formed sequence. Give the result as an irreducible fraction.
